body:
Source-derived optimization proposal; no measured application, token, cost or memory gain is established. The linked published source fragments are byte-identical to inspected local `940fcf220e47d1975f757e76f0b3401691db9358`.

[src/workspace_graph.rs:3991–4015](https://github.com/wavect/semaprax/blob/4f8f598c7935d0a5cdd4a5d5ba5b49d164ae2cfc/src/workspace_graph.rs#L3991-L4015) creates canonical output solely to compare and read its length. [src/format/comments.rs:192–199](https://github.com/wavect/semaprax/blob/4f8f598c7935d0a5cdd4a5d5ba5b49d164ae2cfc/src/format/comments.rs#L192-L199) builds a growing ordinary String; [src/format.rs:260–265](https://github.com/wavect/semaprax/blob/4f8f598c7935d0a5cdd4a5d5ba5b49d164ae2cfc/src/format.rs#L260-L265) already accepts `fmt::Write`.

Candidate: a comparison sink with offset, checked total length and sticky mismatch; execute the complete unchanged commented formatter and keep accepting writes after mismatch. Preserve placement construction, full traversal, bounded scope, and overflow-before-noncanonical diagnostic order. Expected elimination: the complete temporary output String and growth allocations. No direct reservation reduction is proven because this output is an ordinary String; placement/formatter scratch remains.

Use complete independent old/current owning receivers with the same sources/cache state. Preserve all six diagnostic fields and ordering, canonical/source/graph bytes, existing semantic checks and declared work. Charge every genuine new control, backing and operation before acquisition under the actual owner; retain through Drop. No cap changes, refunds, quota reset, fee exemptions, baseline padding, skipped requirements or weakened tests.

Qualify in one focused implementation batch: actual total reservation, allocations/reallocations, allocated bytes and peak live through Drop; zero/one/multiple relevant cases; exact/one-short/zero work and byte limits; malformed/duplicate/interleaved cases; sticky, nested floor and foreign/restored/stale-owner controls as relevant. Run unchanged application owners and disclose failures; physical helper savings do not establish live-agent token gains. Regenerate moved pins using the actual producer; no full quality gates.

Related #754 owns private-layout feature admission, and #825 owns constructor failure propagation. This ticket is a distinct cold-success materialization optimization. Discovery source note is retained locally at `/Volumes/Semaprax/evidence/cold-construction-discovery-940fcf-4f8f598-20261015.md`; only the exact implementation fragments linked above are asserted to exist on the pushed commit.
title: (OPT) Compare canonical commented output without a temporary String
